Class ViewLessons

java.lang.Object
guiLessons.ViewLessons
public class ViewLessons extends Object

Title: ViewLessons Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Lessons Learned page. This class provides the JavaFX GUI widgets that let a logged-in user create, view, search, update and delete lessons learned. Every user can see and search the full team-wide list; only the author of a lesson, or an Admin, may update or delete it. It follows the same singleton View pattern as the other pages: all access starts with the static method displayLessons, which instantiates the class once and then refreshes the parts that change on each use. The page contains no validation or database logic; the Controller calls LessonManager, which performs both.

  • Method Details

    • displayLessons

      public static void displayLessons(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user)

      Method: displayLessons(Stage ps, User user)

      Description: This method is the single entry point from outside this package to cause the Lessons Learned page to be displayed. It sets up the shared attributes, instantiates the class if needed, clears the form, shows the contributor's lessons, and displays the page.

      Parameters:
      ps - specifies the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and it's methods
      user - specifies the User for this GUI and it's methods

    • displayLessons

      public static void displayLessons(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user, boolean isAdmin)

      Method: displayLessons(Stage ps, User user, boolean isAdmin)

      Description: This is the entry point used when an Admin opens this page from Admin Home. It behaves exactly like displayLessons(Stage, User) except that it lets the Admin update or delete any lesson, not just lessons they created themselves.

      Parameters:
      ps - specifies the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and it's methods
      user - specifies the User for this GUI and it's methods
      isAdmin - true when this page is being opened by an Admin
